mapper.sql: password_reset_verification_id AS passwordResetVerificationId, member_id AS memberId, verification_code_hash AS verificationCodeHash, verification_status AS verificationStatus, failed_attempt_count AS failedAttemptCount, verification_code_expires_at AS verificationCodeExpiresAt, reset_token_hash AS resetTokenHash, reset_token_expires_at AS resetTokenExpiresAt, verified_at AS verifiedAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM password_reset_verification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, password_reset_verification_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM password_reset_verification WHERE reset_token_hash = #{resetTokenHash} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_verification SET verification_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND verification_status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED') AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_verification ( member_id, verification_code_hash, verification_status, failed_attempt_count, verification_code_expires_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{verificationCodeHash}, #{verificationStatus}, #{failedAttemptCount}, #{verificationCodeExpiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_verification SET failed_attempt_count = failed_attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE password_reset_verification_id = #{passwordResetVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE password_reset_verification SET verification_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE password_reset_verification_id = #{passwordResetVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE password_reset_verification SET verification_status = 'VERIFIED', reset_token_hash = #{resetTokenHash}, reset_token_expires_at = #{resetTokenExpiresAt}, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE password_reset_verification_id = #{passwordResetVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'PENDING' AND verification_code_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE password_reset_verification SET verification_status = 'USED', used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE password_reset_verification_id = #{passwordResetVerificationId} AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND reset_token_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND used_at IS NULL
